title: Moltres 146/165 Pokemon 151 Holo Rare Pokemon Card NM/MINT Japanese Nintendo

descriptionText:
This Moltres 146/165 Pokemon 151 Holo Rare Pokemon Card NM/MINT Japanese Nintendo is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector. The card features the legendary Moltres character and is a rare find with a holographic design. 

The card is perfect for those who appreciate the Japanese language and culture, as it was manufactured by Nintendo in Japan. It is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress. Don't miss out on the chance to own this amazing card.
